name: verifiable integrity
headline: Integrity you can *verify*
say: Everything has its place by its name, and every byte can be checked, so nothing has to be taken on trust. When someone shares work with you, you receive signatures, and your device checks each piece as it arrives. Content used in many places is stored once, and any host that holds it can hand you a copy. A copy from any host is as good as the original, because it proves itself.
